scope: BUY_AND_ADD_ENTRY_ONLY; early SELL and scheduled horizon CLOSE unchanged; no comparator stress qualification
grid: Each delay at full fraction, plus NEXT_OPEN at 0 and 0.50; six distinct scenarios, no Cartesian search
close_priority: Early pending SELL at OPEN, then original scheduled horizon CLOSE, then pending entry NEXT_CLOSE, then close valuation and policy observation
exposure: Use actual execution point for every existing lot; close entry uses close valuation, other original orders use open valuation
delay_coverage: Observation plus2 requires declared consecutive intermediate and target frames; exact target only, never next available bar
reservation: Keep full original reservation until target attempt, subtract from available cash, refuse duplicate entry for same pending instrument; release all remainder after one attempt, no automatic resubmit; later original policy ADD decisions remain possible
partial_quantity: floor(requested*fraction/registered buy_increment)*buy_increment; original buy_minimum and offset rule still checked; zero/below-minimum produces explicit no fill
horizons: Each actual entry fill retains entry+20 original horizon; baseline migration and early SELL unchanged
unknown: Missing slots/valuation retain null and hard observed failures; no fill is not prediction loss; G5 cannot PASS
